measurement_decoder: For y_L=C^T x and y_T=Mx: x=(C y_L+M^T y_T)/18-(11/90)(sum y_L)1.
theorem: The complementary 40-line and 45-tritangent readers form an 85x36 full-rank frame with R^T R=18I+22J, hence an exact closed-form decoder. Thirty-six sensors are minimal; both possible rank-compatible compositions 15+21 and 16+20 occur.
